item.title: Anthropic and OpenAI release dueling AI models on the same day in an escalating rivalry
item.description: The rivaling AI companies pushed GPT-5.3-Codex and Claude Opus 4.6, and had back-to-back appearances on a tech and business podcast.

item.title: Microsoft AI CEO says vibe coding is making software easier to replace
item.description: Microsoft AI CEO says vibe coding is lowering the barrier to building apps, raising questions about how defensible software will be.

item.title: Digital nomads in Southeast Asia are nothing new — but this city in Vietnam is now on their radar
item.description: As digital nomads flock to Da Nang, Vietnam, questions arise about rising rents, local impact, and the city's evolving status as a remote work hub.

item.title: Airbus is making a rugged tablet for helicopter crews to control a drone team while flying at high speed
item.description: The firm said it recently tested the software with Singapore's air force, where a chopper crew used an ISR drone to find a target in the rainforest.

item.title: An airline offering $2,600 business-class seats on US-Asia routes is expanding its luxury cabin with a new plane
item.description: Taiwan's Starlux is one of the few aviation startups to tackle the full-service air travel market, and is introducing the A350-1000 to its fleet.

item.title: SpaceX has a new way to block Russian Starlink access, and Ukrainians are hailing it as a 'catastrophe' for Moscow
item.description: Early reports indicate that Russian forces are encountering trouble organizing troops at the tactical level after the Starlink changes.

item.title: AI is now part of Coach and Kate Spade designers' workflow
item.description: Tapestry's CEO said the initial sketches of bags and shoes are done by hand, but AI tools help tweak designs and test different colorways.

item.title: Reddit CEO says the platform will thrive not on AI slop but by being a place for 'humans to talk to other humans'
item.description: CEO Steve Huffman said that Reddit's success lies in being a place for authentic human conversation, not a platform flooded with bots.

item.title: Russia says the US is pushing its companies out of Venezuela's energy sector
item.description: Russia could face significant losses in Venezuela after a US operation disrupted years of strategic ties with Caracas.

item.title: 'Today' show host Savannah Guthrie's mother Nancy has gone missing. Here's what we know.
item.description: Nancy Guthrie, mother of "Today" show host Savannah Guthrie, has been missing since February 1. Here's what we know about the case.
